- **Nucleophile:** Component (1), the secondary amine of the substituted pyrrolidine ring.
- **Base:** Component (3), triethylamine.
- **Solvent:** Component (4), N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP).
- **Transformation:** Replacement of the aryl chloride by the pyrrolidinyl nitrogen.
